name: Instance check
description: Boolean check attached to an instance.

name.label: Name
name.description: Unique technical name of the check.
name.help: Used to match and update the same check during synchronization.

description.label: Description
description.description: Functional description of what is checked.
description.help: Explains the operational condition represented by the check.

instance_id.label: Instance
instance_id.help: The check is deleted when its instance is deleted.

value.label: Value
value.description: Current boolean value of the check.
value.help: Enabled means the checked condition is currently valid.
